members.intro2:
1985-2004 -- Grew in Oyama-shi, Tochigi, and graduated from Utsunomiya High. 栃木県小山市出身、栃木県立宇都宮高校卒 2004-2008 -- B.S. @ The University of Tokyo. Started research under the supervision of Tetsuo Takano at ANESC. 東京大学教養学部理科二類、農学部 生産生物学専修 アジア生物資源環境研究センターの高野哲夫先生の下で研究を開始。 2008-2013 -- M.Sc. and Ph.D. @ The University of Univ. Tokyo (@Takano lab). Learned the basics of research. Realized the power of science. 東大 大学院農学生命科学研究科 修士・博士課程 (@高野研)。研究の基礎を学ぶ。 2013-2015 -- Post-doc @ Sarah M. Assmann lab, Penn State University and @ Lab of Plant Molecular Genetics,The University of Univ. Tokyo (PI: Nobuhiro Tsutsumi). Saw professionalism in colleagues. Job hunting was tough... ポスドク @ ペンシルバニア州立大学のSarah M. Assmann先生の研究室 @ 東大院農学生命科学研究科 植物分子遺伝学研究室 (PI: 堤伸浩先生) 恵まれた環境でした。就活で苦戦... 2015-2018 -- Assistant professor @ Lab of Crop Physiology, Hokkaido University (PIs: Kiyoshi Masuda and Kaien Fujino). Started crop genomics. 北海道大学大学院農学研究院 作物生理学研究室 助教 上司は増田清先生と藤野介延先生。作物研究開始。 2019-present -- Associate professor @ ARC-BRESアジア生物資源環境研究センター 准教授
See also Researchmap, GitHub, and ORCID.

members.intro2: 2022-2024 -- Obtained M.Sc. in this lab. The masters thesis was on GWAS with ~100 pearl millet elite lines. 2024-present -- Ph.D. candidate. JSPS Research Fellow (DC1). Working to improve multiple layers of pearl millet genomics, including a GWAS system, gene characterization and tissue culture for transformation / genome efiting. Workin also to develop a millet gene expression database and NGS data analysis tools.
2025-present -- Ph.D. candidate. Working to develop web browser apps for sequence data analysis for democratizing NGS data.
2025-present -- Master's student. Working to develop a vector that can drive transgene expression in bacteria, yeast and plants.
